presentation.name: Catch Go hot-path regressions with benchmarks and benchstat
presentation.summary: Benchmarks the code a component runs once per record on a realistic input, and compares before and after a change so slowdowns and extra allocations are caught.
benefits: Benchmarks the per-record entry point as configured in production, not a helper
Uses realistic payloads, where toy inputs hide the costs that grow with data
Compares base and branch with benchstat instead of a single noisy run
Treats allocations per operation as the stable signal and time as the noisy one
Records figures with date and CPU so the next comparison means something
